description: Amazon Inspector v2 scan type is disabled or suspended
rationale: The current account's selected Region reports this Inspector2 scan type as DISABLED or SUSPENDED. A scan type may be inapplicable when the account has no matching workloads. Missing or transitional states are unknown, not a clean result.
remediation: Determine whether the EC2, ECR, Lambda, Lambda Code or Code Repository scan type applies to in-scope workloads, then enable or resume it as appropriate and verify the resource-level coverage.
